method: Each plan expands the Cartesian product of its axes into isolated H.test cases. Every verify asserts a specific rendered result, persisted project/node/HTML/file result, focus/return path, or captured adapter effect. Screenshots before/after are supplied by the real harness. No renderer business mocks.
id_rule: plan.id followed by .axis-tag for each axis in insertion order; an empty value uses inherit; object values use their explicit tag

coverage_notes: Runtime-select cases inspect and operate every option actually exposed by the fixture, not a sample: project default labels/statuses, special folders including all roots, Inspector icon (default + 24 built-ins + imported custom), section type, template, label/status/custom list, document bookmark targets, Targets units/reset. Per-option disk assertions are accumulated and asserted again in verify.
Destructive fixture deletes, rename propagation, note-tab deletion, history deletion, snapshots mass deletion and rollback are exercised, not skipped.
The note tab list is deleted on disk. The component has no onRemoveNote wired in either App or Inspector; the orphan HTML is explicitly asserted retained, not falsely claimed physically deleted.
Dynamic Add option/button behavior, disabled/protected state, invalid metadata/regex/file input and cancellation branches are explicit tests.

No contextual menu exists inside ProjectSettingsDialog, Inspector, ProjectNotesTabs, KeywordsDialog, TargetsDialog, StatisticsDialog, HistoryDialog, TeamDialog, ProjectAiSettingsDialog, SnapshotsPane, SnapshotManagerDialog or SnapshotDiff. Binder snapshot contextual command identity belongs to the binder domain; this suite covers canonical IPC and actual native submenu callbacks.
All plans use an explicit verify assertion/wait. The expanded case count is derived from the same matrices consumed by the module; authored status is not a claim that Electron has been run.

Floating composition Inspector is also traversed (synopsis, label/status options, editable document notes, drag, close/native toggle). Modal titlebar/Escape/backdrop and snapshot empty/unselected/toggle states have dedicated assertions.

uncovered.name: shell-live
uncovered.reason: shell.openPath/openExternal/showItemInFolder are captured harness adapters. File/open/reveal requests are asserted; the real Windows application/browser/file explorer result is not verified.

uncovered.name: MCP-live-client
uncovered.reason: Generated MCP command and desktop JSON are read and structurally checked. No external Claude client is connected and no live model request is authorized.

uncovered.name: team-real-network
uncovered.reason: Team filters, presence/log files, identity configuration and document navigation use local fictitious peers. Multi-machine NAS/cloud sync transport, concurrent writes and elapsed offline/lock timeouts require separate computers and long-lived sessions.

uncovered.name: targets-time-and-cross-project
uncovered.reason: All reset/all-project/negative/deadline controls and settings/progress effects are exercised. Actual midnight rollover, notifications delivered by the OS, and accumulated writing across a second live project are not simulated or reported as verified.

uncovered.name: backup-timer-and-sync-service
uncovered.reason: Every project backup and sync configuration option persists and inherited keys are removed. Scheduled backups, cloud folder transport and timed auto-sync execution are outside this configuration/editorial scope.

uncovered.name: visual-human-review
uncovered.reason: Harness screenshots and functional/DOM/focus assertions support full traversal. Pixel-level aesthetics, occlusion and usability still require the parent's serial visual inspection of the real app screenshots.

uncovered.name: native-dialog-visual-and-confirm-cancel
uncovered.reason: Native file dialog paths/cancellation and exported extension effects are exercised through the harness response adapter, not visual interaction with Windows file-picker controls. The harness auto-accepts renderer confirm dialogs; the alternate cancel button of destructive confirmations cannot be selected without replacing that fixed adapter and is explicitly not claimed covered.
